checks.new_runs: R and Python each run a negative-strength Pitman-Yor model; byte-identical draws/allocations/diagnostics; targets independently reconstructed using sequential prediction

independent_review.scope: Separate slice-audit agent read PYP source and CLI, checking negative strength, singleton updates, canonical partition target, validation and output metadata; no material defect reported.

corrections.description: The first standalone core test run exposed an empty-product quadrature helper error. Explicit multiplicative identity fixed the helper; no sampler change was required.

limits: The implemented component model is univariate Gaussian location with fixed observation variance and a Normal base.
Exact finite-state transition tests and tiny posterior checks do not establish mixing or runtime performance on larger datasets.
Split-merge, tempering and hierarchical species-sampling models remain unimplemented for this entry point.
Julia ran using a directly selected installed binary and a writable temporary depot overlay; no package environment changes were needed.
